nAppr.text:
APPROVAL CARDS (key interaction)
• When the model calls a write tool, the stream pauses and a 'Waiting for your decision' row appears. Each proposed change is one card: a RadzenCard (Variant.Outlined) in the transcript.
• Card header: action RadzenBadge with icon (Create page / Update page / Create folder), target path in monospace, state badge, and an icon RadzenButton (open_in_full) that opens the full-screen diff via DialogService.
• Diff: custom unified-diff markup in a CSS grid (old line no. / new line no. / sign / text). Rows carry + or − plus a tint. Unchanged runs longer than 3 lines fold into a 'Show N unchanged lines' text button. A new page is all + lines; long ones show 12 lines and then a 'Show all' row.
• Footer: Reject (Outlined) first, then Apply (Primary).
• With 2 or more cards, a sticky bar pins to the bottom of the message list: 'N of M decided', a RadzenProgressBar, Reject all, Apply all.
• Focus order: the first pending card's Apply gets focus when the cards arrive. Within a card: Expand → Reject → Apply. Then the sticky bar: Reject all → Apply all. Esc (focus in chat) = Stop, which turns pending cards into Cancelled. Sending a new message turns them into Superseded; the composer says so before you send.
• After apply: the tree refreshes without stealing selection, and the chat adds a 'Pages changed' note with citation chips.

nDlg.text:
NAME AND MOVE DIALOGS
DialogService.OpenAsync<NameDialog> (Width 420, ShowClose, CloseDialogOnEsc).
• RadzenTemplateForm + RadzenTextBox (autofocused; on Rename the name is preselected without '.md') + inline validator messages (icon + text, linked with aria-describedby).
• Validates while typing: invalid characters \ / : * ? " < > |, a trailing dot or space, reserved names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1–9, LPT1–9), an existing name (case-insensitive) and length.
• The primary button is disabled while the name is invalid. Enter submits; Esc cancels.
• Move to: a RadzenTree of folders only, with the root first. The current folder is labeled 'Current' and disabled; for a folder move, the folder itself and its descendants are disabled. The destination path is previewed in monospace.
Focus order: field → Cancel → primary → close.

nDlg2.text:
CONFIRM AND RESULT DIALOGS
• Delete: the counts come from a dry-run scan. Recycle Bin variant: a Danger button, 'Move to Recycle Bin'. Permanent variant (no Recycle Bin): a Danger RadzenAlert and a type-the-name RadzenTextBox; 'Delete permanently' stays disabled until the name matches.
• Conflict on save: Reload (default), Overwrite (danger outlined), Cancel.
• Unsaved changes: Save (default), Discard, Cancel. Window close uses the same dialog (MAUI Window close / beforeunload).
• Rename or move with link updates: a progress dialog (RadzenProgressBar; no close button until it's done), then a success result or a warning result that lists the pages that failed, each one clickable.
Initial focus: the default button, except on destructive dialogs, where Cancel gets focus.

nEdit.text:
EDITOR STATES
• Mode switch: RadzenSelectBar Design | Source | Preview. Design = RadzenMarkdownEditor (WYSIWYG). Source = raw Markdown with line numbers in monospace. Preview = read-only rendered page; wiki links are real links that open the page, and an unresolved link opens the New page dialog prefilled.
• Properties: a collapsible RadzenFieldset. A YAML parse error shows a warning RadzenBadge ('Invalid YAML') plus the line message and highlights the line. Save stays enabled.
• Empty state: a centered RadzenStack with New page and New folder buttons and a shortcut list.
• Page no longer exists: a RadzenAlert (Warning) above the editor. The buffer stays editable. Actions: Save as new page (primary) and Close.

nExpl.text:
EXPLORER STATES
• Context menu: RadzenContextMenu (ContextMenuService.Open with RadzenMenuItems): Open · New page here · New folder here · Rename (F2) · Move to… · Delete (Del). Opens on right-click, Shift+F10 or the Menu key. Arrow keys move, Enter runs, Esc closes and returns focus to the node.
• Drag and drop: HTML5 drag events on the RadzenTree item Template (draggable, @ondragover, @ondrop). A valid target gets a dashed primary outline plus a drive_file_move icon. An invalid target (a folder into itself or a descendant) gets a dashed danger outline, a block icon and a tooltip with the reason. The keyboard alternative is Move to….
• Search: RadzenTextBox with a 200 ms debounce. Results replace the tree (RadzenDataList): title, monospace path, and a snippet of about 160 characters with <mark> highlights. Down arrow enters the results; Esc clears the search and restores the tree.
• Unsaved dot: an 8 px circle with aria-label 'unsaved changes' and a tooltip, so it's announced and isn't a color cue alone.

nFirst.text:
FIRST RUN
• The knowledge root is created with a seeded Welcome.md, which opens selected.
• A dismissible RadzenAlert (Info, AllowClose) above the editor says where the files live; Open folder is desktop only.
• The Welcome page shows all four link forms, and one deliberately unresolved link so the style is learned early.
• Chat shows the no-API-key card and a disabled composer until a key is configured.

nMain.text:
DESIGN SYSTEM
Base: Radzen Blazor 12, Material theme, compact density. The tokens are overrides of the --rz-* variables, kept in one small app.css and switched by RadzenAppearanceToggle (ThemeService: material / material-dark). The --kgb-* tokens are app-specific additions.

Fonts: Roboto (the Material default) for the UI. JetBrains Mono for YAML, paths, diffs, tool rows and keyboard hints.

Custom CSS on top of Radzen (about 200 lines): .wl wiki link, .wu unresolved link (dashed underline, warning color, link_off icon), .cite citation chip, .tool row, .diff with .add/.rm rows and a +/− sign column, .unsaved-dot, and icon + word status badges (RadzenBadge with BadgeStyle).

Accessibility: all text is at least 4.5:1 in both themes. Every focusable element gets a 2 px primary ring with a 2 px offset. Status is never shown by color alone: badges carry an icon and a word, diff rows carry + or −, and unresolved links carry an icon and a dashed underline.

nNarrow.text:
NARROW (under 900 px)
• RadzenSplitter is replaced by RadzenTabs (RenderMode.Client, so each panel keeps its state): Explorer, Editor, Chat.
• The Editor tab shows the unsaved dot. The Chat tab shows a RadzenBadge with the number of pending approvals (aria-label '2 approvals pending').
• Opening a page from the tree or from a citation chip switches to the Editor tab.
• The header keeps the app icon and root name; Settings becomes an icon button.
• Tabs and primary actions are 44 px tall for touch.
• The sticky approval bar stacks its buttons full width.
• Focus order: header → tab list (arrow keys between tabs) → the active panel.

nSet.text:
SETTINGS (route /settings)
RadzenLayout body > a centered RadzenStack (max-width 760) of RadzenCard sections.
• Knowledge root: RadzenFormField + monospace RadzenTextBox + Browse (folder picker, desktop only) + Apply. Inline validation: drive roots are refused (error); more than 10,000 pages gives a warning.
• AI provider: RadzenDropDown for the provider, RadzenTextBox for the model. The Endpoint RadzenTextBox appears only for Azure OpenAI and Ollama. API key: RadzenBadge 'Configured' / 'Not set' + a Replace button that opens a dialog with RadzenPassword. The key is never rendered back. Privacy note: RadzenAlert (Info).
• Graph: stat tiles + Rebuild graph RadzenButton → RadzenProgressBar → result line.
• Appearance: RadzenAppearanceToggle with a label.
Focus order: back link → each card top to bottom; each Apply follows its field.

nSetB.text:
SETTINGS · BROWSER HOST (Blazor WebAssembly on localhost)
The same page, driven by a host capability flag (CanEditSettings = false).
• Knowledge root shows only the folder name, read-only with a lock icon, and notes that it's configured on the server.
• AI provider: every field is read-only and there's no Replace button. The key status is still shown.
• Graph rebuild and Appearance stay available.
• Read-only fields use ReadOnly, not Disabled, so they stay in the tab order and screen readers announce their values.

nStates.text:
CARD STATES (icon + word, never color alone)
Pending — schedule, neutral. Apply and Reject enabled.
Approved — check, primary. 'Waiting for 1 more decision', with Undo.
Applied — check_circle, success. Diff collapses; 'Open page' link.
Rejected — block, neutral. Diff collapses; 'Show diff' reopens it.
Not applied (conflict) — warning, warning color. The file changed on disk after the proposal; offers Open current page and Ask again.
Cancelled — cancel, neutral. The user pressed Stop.
Superseded — redo, neutral. The user sent a new message instead.
Create folder cards have no diff, just the resulting path.
Decided cards keep their header so the transcript stays auditable.

Full-screen diff: RadzenDialog (Width 90vw, Height 85vh, ShowClose, CloseDialogOnEsc) with a wider gutter and the same Reject / Apply footer. Esc closes it and returns focus to the Expand button.

nSys.text:
NOTIFICATIONS AND SYSTEM STATES
• Toasts: NotificationService.Notify with Severity Success / Info / Warning / Error, top right. Success and info close after 4 s; warnings and errors stay until dismissed. A custom template adds actions (Retry, Open, Show in tree).
• Chat errors are transcript items. Retryable ones (rate limit, network, overloaded) get Retry. Non-retryable ones say what to do next.
• No API key: an inline card with a RadzenLink to /settings; the composer is disabled.
• Skeletons: a light CSS shimmer for the tree, editor and chat while the index loads.
• Not Found: a short 404 inside the shell, with a link back to Workspace.

nWork.text:
WORKSPACE · DESKTOP (900 px and wider)
• Shell: RadzenLayout > RadzenHeader holding RadzenIcon, RadzenText, a root chip, a RadzenLink to /settings and RadzenAppearanceToggle. No RadzenSidebar.
• Panes: RadzenSplitter with 3 RadzenSplitterPanes: Explorer 272 px (min 200), Editor flexible, Chat 420 px (min 320). Resizable; sizes persist.
• Explorer: icon-only RadzenButtons (Variant.Text, Size.Small, aria-label + title), RadzenTextBox search, RadzenTree with lazy Expand/LoadChildren and an item Template (icon, name, unsaved dot). RadzenContextMenu opens via ContextMenuService.
• Editor: RadzenText title + RadzenBreadCrumb; Save / Revert RadzenButtons; RadzenSelectBar Design | Source | Preview; Properties = RadzenFieldset AllowCollapse holding a monospace RadzenTextArea; RadzenMarkdownEditor; Links panel = RadzenFieldset with three groups and RadzenBadge counts.
• Chat: header with a provider/model chip and a New chat RadzenButton; message list; composer = RadzenTextArea + Send RadzenButton (it becomes Stop while streaming).

Shortcuts: Ctrl+S save · F2 rename · Delete delete (tree) · Enter send · Shift+Enter new line · Esc closes menus and dialogs, and stops a stream when focus is in chat.

Focus order: header (Settings, theme) → Explorer toolbar → search → tree (one tab stop, arrow keys inside) → editor header (Save, Revert, mode) → Properties → editor body → Links panel → chat header → messages (citation chips) → composer → Send/Stop.
